module: Auxiliary controller (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 50) for pneumatic cylinders with simplified gas physics: an air tank (energyStorage) feeds, via valves, "virtual buffers" (cross-flow groups) then the pressurized beams of a group. The flows depend on pressure differences and passage cross-sections, the air's energy is conserved (PV = e) and the air consumption empties the tank. One valve per group (valveState -1..1) opens the intake (> 0) or the exhaust; it can be read from an electrics value. It also plays sounds according to the flow.
usage:
local a = controller.getControllerSafe('pneumatics/actuators')
a.setBeamGroupValveState('liftAxle', 1)    -- intake
local p = a.getAveragePressure('liftAxle') -- in absolute Pa
notes: Units: pressures in pascals (absolute), flows in m³/s, radii in m. An electrics value <controllerName>_<group>_pressure_avg receives the average relative pressure (average - ambient pressure).

Controller jbeam keys (default): airTankName ("mainAirTank"), pressuredBeams (v.data table name with beamName, groupName, crossFlowTag (default = groupName), supplyHoseRadius, supplyValveRadius, maxSupplyPressure, maxSupplyPressurePSI, valveStateElectricsName, disableAirConsumption, debug), crossFlowGroups (table name with crossFlowTag, virtualBufferCapacity, debug), supplyHoseRadius (0.0075 m), supplyValveRadius (0.2 * supplyHoseRadius), maxSupplyPressure (infinite), maxSupplyPressurePSI (converted to absolute pressure + 101325 Pa), virtualBufferCapacity (0.005 m³), pressureDumpFlowRate (0.01 m³/s), crossFlowBetweenBeams (boolean), debug (boolean), groupSounds (table name with groupName, node, volume/volumeIncrease/volumeDecrease, soundIncrease, soundDecrease, startFlowRateThreshold..., stopFlowRateThreshold..., flowRateVolumeFactor...).
Beam fields read: name, pressure (default pressure), maxPressure, beamSpring, beamDamp, surface (cross-section in m²), lengthOffset.
If the tank is not found, an error is logged and updateFixedStep becomes nop; but updateGFX stays active and reads uninitialized data (inferred from code: avoid).

valveState > 0: the buffer is fed by the tank (limited by maxSupplyPressure); valveState <= 0: the buffer empties to the atmosphere. If valveState = 0 (and no crossFlowBetweenBeams) there is no exchange with the beams.
An implicit cross-flow group is created (with a warning) if a crossFlowTag is not declared in crossFlowGroups.
The computation is executed at every physics step (updateFixedStep) and can be costly.

init.desc: Builds beam groups, virtual buffers and flow parameters from the jbeam and finds the air tank.

initSounds.desc: Creates the flow increase/decrease sound sources for each group. Called by the controller manager.

reset.desc: Resets pressures, stored energies, valves and virtual buffers to their initial state.

resetSounds.desc: Cuts the sound volume and resets their state.

updateFixedStep.desc: Every physics step: computes the tank -> buffers -> beams flows, updates the pressures and the tank's energy, applies the pressures to the beams.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: handles the sounds according to the flow, resets the per-tick energies to zero, writes the average relative pressure into electrics and draws the debug graphs.

setBeamGroupValveState.desc: Sets the valve state of a group.

valveState.desc: -1..1; > 0 intake, <= 0 exhaust; the absolute value sets the opening.

toggleBeamGroupValveState.desc: Toggles the valve between 1 (intake) and -1 (exhaust): if the current state is < 0 it goes to 1, otherwise to -1.

setBeamGroupMaximumSupplyPressure.desc: Sets the maximum supply pressure of a group.

setBeamGroupCrossFlowTag.desc: Changes the virtual buffer (cross-flow group) a group is connected to; resets the buffer if the group is the first to use it.

getValveState.desc: Returns the valve state of a group (0 if not found).

getAverageFlowRate.desc: Returns the average flow to the beams of a group (m³/s; 0 if not found).

getAveragePressure.desc: Returns the average pressure of the beams of a group (absolute Pa; 0 if not found).

getBeamGroupsAverageFlowRate.desc: Returns the average of the average flows of several groups.

returns.desc: Average flow (0 if the list is empty).
